jobs.title: Associate Chief Information Officer, Research Information Technology
jobs.description: Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Associate Chief Information Officer, Research Information Technology (ACIO) provides executive leadership for the institution’s research technology portfolio, with responsibility for long-range planning across research applications, research computing, research data management, secure data and computing environments, and the strategic adoption of advanced technologies. Lead and develop teams delivering research applications, research computing, secure data services, research software engineering, and related support functions, with clear roles, expectations, and professional growth pathways.

jobs.title: Associate Director for Consulting, Center for Advanced Computing
jobs.description: As Associate Director for Consulting, you will lead a team of professionals who collaborate with Cornell faculty and research groups to find and deliver solutions to complex computational problems. These solutions may comprise programming, code improvement, website or database options, education, or expert consulting. You will participate in multi-institutional efforts, including leading dispersed teams for funded collaborations, and you will lead planning and implementation efforts for externally funded team projects, such as an online HPC training environment. As part of CAC’s leadership team, you will partner with the Director and the Associate Director for Operations and Systems on planning, strategic decision-making, budgeting, staffing, service offerings, rate-setting, and policies and procedures to support CAC’s smooth operation.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Digital Scientific Workflows
jobs.description: The candidate will be tasked with solving complex business workflows, data capture, analysis, and visualization challenges in an interdisciplinary, collaborative environment using cutting-edge digital technologies.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Laboratory Informatics Platforms
jobs.description: Alnylam is seeking an Associate Director, Laboratory Informatics Platforms to lead the strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operational stewardship of core laboratory informatics capabilities across Research and Early Development (ReDev) and CMC. The role will own all aspects of product and technology lifecycle for electronic lab notebook (ELN), sample management, entity registration, workflow orchestration, and instrument data capture capabilities for ReDev and CMC.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Research Technology & Scientific Computing
jobs.description: The successful candidate will be a trusted technology partner to scientists and R&D leaders, translating evolving research priorities into roadmaps, capabilities, and measurable outcomes. Translate scientific priorities and emerging opportunities into an integrated roadmap for laboratory technology, research applications, scientific computing, cloud and on-premises services, data flows, and supporting infrastructure. Lead the lifecycle, reliability, service health, supplier performance, and continual improvement of Research Technology capabilities.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Technical Solutions
jobs.description: The Associate Director, Technical Solutions will lead a highly skilled team of technical professionals responsible for specialized education solutions, computing infrastructure, instructional technologies, laboratories, and research computing environments across a complex, multi-campus setting. This role offers the opportunity to shape technical strategy, strengthen education and research computing capacity, and guide the continued evolution of services that support academic and research excellence. Working closely with academic leaders, researchers, and technical professionals, the Associate Director will provide strategic leadership in education technology, infrastructure planning, emerging technologies, cybersecurity, lifecycle management, and sustainable service models.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President of Research Computing
jobs.description: Operationally, the AVP is responsible for developing effective service models, facilities, and capabilities that support the University's research enterprise. The role provides strategic leadership and oversight for the Center for Research Computing, ensuring efficient operations, effective communication with the Research Computing Committee, and strong alignment with partner organizations across the technology enterprise, including information security functions. The AVP partners closely with stakeholders across Rice University to understand the evolving computational needs of the research community and develop sustainable solutions that leverage on-campus infrastructure, cloud technologies, advanced storage, and emerging computing resources.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics platform manager
jobs.company: New Brunswick Institute of Health Research
jobs.description: The platform manager will perform their duties in line with their expertise for the coordination and planning of research and operational activities at the NB-IHR bioinformatics platform. Management and quality checks of data generated through collaboration with in-house PIs, other technological platforms, outside clients or large consortia in which NB-IRS participates. Scheduling service and maintenance of servers and other technology at the platform. Coordinating with partner organizations (Vitalité, UMoncton) when servicing, networking or acquiring technology to ensure smooth operations.

jobs.title: Data & AI Services Group Lead
jobs.description: The Data and AI Services (DAS) Group at NERSC provides AI, analytics, and data management support to more than 11,000 users, addressing challenges at the intersection of AI, simulations, and experimental data. The DAS Group Leader will lead, mentor, and guide the team while helping develop and execute NERSC, Computing Sciences Area, and Department of Energy strategic initiatives in AI and advanced computing. The group advises users on AI, data analysis, and complex workflows; provides training in AI/ML and data management; supports software and large-scale data challenges; and collaborates across Berkeley Lab research initiatives.

jobs.title: Director for Emerging Technologies and Research
jobs.description: The role will be overseeing the HPRC research and user services effort; maintaining a high-quality user experience for faculty and researchers at Texas A&M and nationally; building and developing stronger research collaborations across campus and nationally; enabling the computational and data-enabled research projects of faculty, researchers and students by utilizing large and complex HPRC systems and data resources; researching and evaluating emerging technologies in advanced computing and AI; representing TAMU HPRC on local, regional and national events and activities. Directs and develops the HPRC User Services with a mission to provide new researchers a robust suite of support services for high-performance computing and big data analysis solutions.

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer - AI Computing System
jobs.description: Focusing on the company's large model training optimization field, lead the team to build key technologies such as low-precision training, parallel strategy tuning, and training resource optimization, promoting the commercial implementation of large model perception optimization-related technologies. Focusing on the company's training servers and super nodes and other products, lead the team to build large model AI training frameworks, operator libraries, acceleration libraries, and other software frameworks and acceleration features, fully leveraging system engineering and software-hardware collaboration capabilities to enhance AI cluster computing efficiency.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, GPU Infrastructure
jobs.location: San Francisco CA USA or Canada
jobs.description: The GPU Clusters team builds and operates the superclusters that train Cohere’s frontier models. We sit at the intersection of hardware, distributed systems, and AI research. We work with cloud providers, researchers, and other infrastructure teams on problems few companies get to take on. As an Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a team of engineers who care deeply about GPU infrastructure. You’ll set technical direction, grow people, and help the company scale a rapidly growing compute footprint.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Rosalind Workbench
jobs.description: We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team building Rosalind Workbench and its supporting infrastructure. You’ll hire and develop engineers, set technical direction, and turn an ambitious product roadmap into focused, reliable releases. This is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable reviewing architecture and code, investigating difficult failures, and helping engineers make consequential technical decisions. You’ll work closely with product, design, research, Codex engineering, and customer-facing teams to bring new scientific capabilities into everyday use.

jobs.title: Group Leader, Quantum HPC Group
jobs.description: The QHPC Group Leader will provide Research and Development (R&D) leadership to the group that strategically advances the laboratory and DOE’s research portfolio in the field. The Group Leader leads a group of quantum computing researchers with the primary goal of pursuing global scientific leadership in the quantum computing field, nurtures ORNL’s culture among group members, and continues to build and scale up individual excellence and impact in R&D. The Group Leader will initiate, lead and perform independent R&D on an ongoing basis. The Group Leader will also partner with scientific domain experts and help them obtain optimal results from the ORNL’s quantum/HPC computational resources and systems.

jobs.title: Head of Agentic AI and Data Science Research
jobs.description: The Head of Agentic AI and Data Science Research leads the FCA's capability at the frontier of applied AI, ensuring the organisation not only adopts emerging technologies but understands, shapes and governs them in a way that supports its public interest objectives. It provides strategic leadership for AI research, model governance, data science capability, and horizon scanning. The role owns the FCA's medium and longer-term AI agenda, translating emerging opportunities and risks into actionable strategies, governance frameworks and capability roadmaps. It also leads the FCA Data Science Profession and provides technical thought leadership to senior decision-makers across the organisation and wider regulatory, and technology stakeholder communities.

jobs.title: Head of Lab Technology Platforms
jobs.description: The Head of Lab Technology Platforms will support the strategic and operational advancement of Baylor Genetics’ laboratory technology infrastructure. This role will focus on optimizing bioinformatics pipelines, data systems and LIMS, and facilitating QA, QM activities to ensure scalable, efficient, and compliant genomic computational operations. The Head will collaborate cross-functionally to implement technology solutions that enhance throughput, reduce turnaround times, and support innovation in clinical diagnostics.

jobs.title: Manager of Research Engineering, TR Labs
jobs.description: As Manager of Research Engineering, you are both a technical leader and a people manager. You will help shape the technical direction for production services, build deep partnerships across the enterprise, and take ownership of recruiting, career growth, and mentorship for Labs engineers. You will provide technical guidance on complex, high-impact projects in close collaboration with the research arm of Labs, and champion the adoption of industry best practices around well-managed software delivery. Lead a cross-functional project team spanning research and engineering. Operate as an excellent cross-functional influencer, bridging the gap between applied science and production engineering.

jobs.title: Manager, AI & Research Computing Initiatives, IS&T Research Computing
jobs.description: Join us as the Manager, AI & Research Computing Initiatives, where you will lead IS&T's strategy and planning for artificial intelligence in research computing within Research Computing Services (RCS). You will set and drive the technical roadmap for AI-enabled research computing, coordinate the facilitation, technology, and infrastructure support RCS provides to Boston University researchers, and serve as the primary technical bridge between IS&T and the University's academic and research community. As part of RCS, you will supervise the team executing this work day-to-day and partner with research computing leadership on the broader research computing strategy, specifically representing the AI/ML dimension.

jobs.title: Principal Architect, AI & High Performance Systems
jobs.description: This is a principal-level, hands-on architect role with the Forward Deployed Engineering Team at KX. You assess customer environments and design AI-enabled, high-performance data and analytics systems, deciding where KX can create material value across AI, real-time data processing, accelerated computing and infrastructure modernisation. Working with the most innovative Investment Banks, Hedge Funds Market Makers and exchanges globally, you define how KX and their wider technology estate should work together in this new era of technology disruption. You are the technical authority in the room, and the credibility of the architecture is yours to defend.

jobs.title: Product Manager HPCWorks Tools
jobs.description: In this role, you will define product strategy, prioritize investment, and work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to address complex cloud orchestration challenges. Success requires a strong understanding of end-to-end HPC workflows, the broader infrastructure ecosystem, and the ability to identify underlying customer requirements in sophisticated enterprise environments. Define product vision and roadmap for HPCWorks Navops in alignment with customer needs, Siemens HPC strategy, and market direction.

jobs.title: R&D Manager, Quantum Computer Science
jobs.description: We are seeking a Manager to lead Sandia's Quantum Computer Science Department, a multidisciplinary R&D organization advancing foundational quantum computing research. The selected candidate will provide people, technical, operational, and strategic leadership for a high-performing research department. Key responsibilities include staff development, program development, sponsor engagement, strategic planning, and partnership building across Sandia, the broader national laboratory complex, academia, industry, and federal agencies. This role offers the opportunity to shape Sandia's quantum information science strategy and help advance quantum technologies in support of national needs.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Researcher & Technical Leader – Agentic RL for Distributed Computing
jobs.description: As a Senior Principal leader at Huawei Canada Research Center, you will be the primary technical authority and strategic visionary for our Distributed AI Infrastructure. Your mission is to architect the "chassis" for the next era of intelligence: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). Lead technical innovation and exploration of AI infrastructure distributed systems for reinforcement learning and multi-agent systems. Drive multi-tier research and multi-scenario applications to build core technical competitiveness and support commercial success.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead
jobs.description: The Senior Technical Lead role acts at the department's senior researchcomputing and enterprise IT lead supporting both advanced scientific computing and administrative digital transformation, including safe AI technologies. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership and specialized expertise in research computing infrastructure, systems and network administration, programming, automation, enterprise applications, and business systems analysis within a complex and evolving academic research environment.The role will lead all departmental cybersecurity initiatives including risk assessments, vulnerability mitigation, secure system design, identity and access management, incident response coordination, and alignment with evolving and strengthened University security standards. Working closely with faculty, students, and staff, you will support all research groups by serving as the department’s primary technical advisor and institutional IT liaison for research computing, consulting and partnering with faculty and research teams to design and/or adopt scalable, secure, and reproducible computational research environments throughout the research lifecycle.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Quantum Computing, Amazon Braket
jobs.location: Seattle WA or New York NY USA
jobs.description: You will drive programs and solutions that help customers experiment with quantum technologies, develop new skills, discover potential applications, and plan for the future. Responsibilities include managing programs that span multiple engineering and applied science teams and other AWS services. You will drive integration activities with our external quantum hardware partners, defining and delivering against operational and security requirements. You will be a force multiplier, contributing to the strategic and tactical planning of the organization, setting goals and helping to prioritize resources.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Quantum Computing Applied Research
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact strategic R&D initiatives within quantum computing. You will lead across our applied research R&D roadmap to craft clarity and success. Initiate and lead multiple concurrent technical programs across our quantum computing portfolio, with emphasis on bringing the full power of accelerated computing to the field. Serve as a link between research and engineering, moving new technologies from incubation to scalable solutions.

jobs.title: Sr. AI Science Lead
jobs.description: As a Senior AI Science Lead, you will set scientific direction and technical strategy for large-scale AI research programs that advance drug discovery. You will lead a team of AI scientists and AI engineers while driving major initiatives across computational chemistry, computational genomics, and related domains, ensuring alignment between scientific priorities and organizational goals. In partnership with Lilly Research Labs and engineering and technology leaders, you will transform cutting-edge research into scalable capabilities that accelerate scientific impact.

jobs.title: Workloads and Benchmarking Team Lead
jobs.description: As the Workloads and Benchmarking Team Lead, you will lead the Specialized Workloads and Benchmarking group, owning the strategy and execution of benchmarking for Azure HPC and AI infrastructure. You will develop deep expertise in HPC and AI workloads, define representative and credible benchmarking methodologies, and drive external publication of results that influence customer adoption and internal platform design. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management, including coaching, mentoring, and growing a high-performing team of engineers.

jobs.title: Head of AI Core Unit / Data Scientist - BioSysteM
jobs.description: We are looking for an Independent junior research group leader (m/f/d) with knowledge of data / AI science to set up and lead the AI Core Unit of the BioSysteM Cluster of Excellence as soon as possible. The position is initially for 4 years and can be extended until 31.12.2032
